create_PlasmaArray_wrapper: create a PlasmaArray wrapper around a numpy array to enable shared memory serialization
start_PlasmaArray_server: start the plasma_store subprocess server for a PlasmaArray instance with allocated memory
connect_PlasmaArray_client: connect a PlasmaArray client to the plasma store socket path with retries
serialize_PlasmaArray_getstate: serialize a PlasmaArray by putting the numpy array into shared memory and returning pickled state
deserialize_PlasmaArray_setstate: deserialize a PlasmaArray by retrieving the numpy array from shared memory using the object ID
